Although the operating margin is strong at approximately 25% (EBIT / revenue = 12,435M / 49,691M), the low asset turnover (revenue / total assets ≈ 0.0146) and negative working capital (current assets - current liabilities = -1,492,522M) suggest inefficiency and vulnerability to default. Based on these distress signals, the issuer falls into the CCC category, indicating substantial credit risk with current vulnerability to non-payment.

DECISION: CCC
